constrained_decoding.mechanism_detail: LocalOpenVinoBackend sets GenerationConfig.structured_output_config to a compound StructuredOutputConfig.Tag("<tool_call>", JSONSchema(tool-call object), "</tool_call>") on steps with expect_tool_call=True.
